ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake: Nightside Ice
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
NIGHTSIDEICE_RM_MOD_BUILD_1 (Phase A row 5 of design/RimMandrake/biome_mod_architecture.md; parent BIOME_MOD_SPLIT_EXECUTION_1). The Nightside Ice, fully generalized: it names no other franchise or campaign and is playable standalone on any generated RimWorld planet. A separate frozen campaign world's own instance is unaffected; this is a new sibling biome for everyone else's worlds, not a rename of that one.
RM tier: nothing here knows what campaign or planet uses it.
Dirty white ice, geologically young and impure, on the highest ground of the deep night. There is no soil for plants to grow in, and almost no animal life — the entire biome is deliberately near-empty (§6 of the source sheet: no photosynthesis or photosynthetic tissue of any kind, no ordinary animal silhouettes). `workerClass` stays the vanilla Core `BiomeWorker_IceSheet` — the twin never used a donor type, so this mod owes no `RM_BiomeWorker_NightsideIce` of its own.
This is the thinnest row in the biome-mod-split wave: no kit spec exists for this biome and no mechanic is shipped or owed here (the roster's unbuilt tunnelers, icy insects and landform catalysts are separate, not-yet-filed authoring work). Ships only the BiomeDef itself, unaltered from its twin except for the defName and the eviction of the one Star Wars canon row.
⛔ Star Wars canon fauna does NOT ship here — Q11a (owner ruling, 2026-09-22): a genuinely canon name is IP and must route through the Utinni campaign patch layer, never the franchise-free RimMandrake tier. `RSW_CaveLemming` rides src/RimUtinni/UtinniPatches/Patches/WildAnimals_NightsideIce.xml instead; this def ships only the 7 non-Star-Wars `AA_*` rows (Alpha Animals, `sarg.alphaanimals`) the twin already carried.
Live proof (step 5, a scratch-world quicktest with all five expansions) is Desktop-only and OWED — see the item's own verify record.
